primary.headline: Borivali yellow: Light showers possible
primary.summary: Dry conditions are most likely through the next hour. Brief light showers may develop later, but no heavy-rain signal is evident for Borivali.

primary.agentNote: Radar and the Borivali gauge favor a dry first hour; model guidance supports intermittent light-shower risk later. A mostly dry outcome remains plausible.

outlook.headline: Yellow alert: Light, intermittent shower risk around Mumbai through Sep 2
outlook.modelRead: ECMWF keeps a light, intermittent coastal-to-Mumbai shower signal at its nightly checkpoints. The supplied GFS frames are less frequent and, where they overlap, are generally drier or differ on timing; neither model shows a clear local heavy-rain core.
outlook.reasoning: The five forecast windows retain a yellow alert because light showers are possible in or near Mumbai, especially along the west coast, while confidence is reduced by incomplete timing overlap between the supplied model frames. ECMWF provides checkpoints on each night from Aug 28 to Sep 1. The supplied GFS charts begin at 05:30 IST on Aug 30 and then arrive every 48 hours, so it cannot directly verify every daily window. The pressure charts show broadly weak local gradients around 1008-14 hPa, with more organized low-pressure and heavier precipitation signals displaced inland or north/east of Mumbai. Wind vectors are not shown.
